newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close slightly higher, rangebound.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close slightly higher, rangebound.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled barely firmer in rangebound trade amid an ongoing bearish fundamental picture and weak technicals, market sources said.
PaineWebber analyst Bernard Savaiko said prices could remain in their recent range until May garners enough momentum to pierce its overhead target of 86.90 cents.
Nearby resistance was seen at 79.50 cents and support at 72.50 cents basis the spot May contract.
May closed up 0.30 cent at 76.05 cents. Most-active July also settled 0.30 cent per lb firmer at 77.95 cents per lb, having traded from 78.20 to 77.10 cents.
Volume was estimated at 3,800 lots compared with Wednesday's official 4,558 lots.
Players await the weekly movement figure released later today.
